name: Claude Pin
description: Pin a Claude Code account to each project. Agents Orca launches in a pinned project start with that account. Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

settings.title: Orca data folder
settings.description: Where Orca keeps claude-profiles/. Leave empty for the default (%APPDATA%\orca, ~/Library/Application Support/orca or ~/.config/orca).

settings.title: Routed agents
settings.description: Orca agent ids to route, comma separated.

settings.title: When a pin cannot be applied
settings.description: A pinned project's account is missing or signed out, the plugin cannot tell which project a workspace belongs to, or the launch cannot be pinned: Agent Teams, a Claude command that sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR itself, Windows with an account selected. Refuse the launch, or start it on Orca's own account selection.

settings.title: Trust workspaces in the pinned account
settings.description: Orca marks a workspace trusted only in the selected account, so a pinned account would stop at Claude's trust prompt. This does the same for the pinned account. Turn it off if you turned off Orca's own workspace trust: the plugin cannot read that setting.

settings.title: Show each account's usage
settings.description: Off by default. While the panel is open, reads each account's stored access token and asks Anthropic's usage endpoint, as Orca does for its own usage bar. The token goes nowhere else and is not refreshed.
